findings.mechanism: Uncaught std::out_of_range from ssize_t parse → std::terminate → svcBreak
findings.notes: Exact boundary at SSIZE_MAX. Values 0-SMAX → 206 OK, SMAX+1+ → crash. Same pattern as CVE-2026-31870 but in Range header.

findings.trigger: GET /data.json with Content-Length: 1024 body (1024 bytes of 0x41)
findings.mechanism: Originally thought to be cleanup/teardown crash. NOT REPRODUCIBLE in isolation.
findings.notes: Observed once during marathon fuzzer (test #35+). Isolated reproduction attempted with 16 body sizes (0-65536B) — zero crashes. Also tested: pipelining with body, HTTP desync, 50 rapid connection cycles, 20 RST connections, half-open connections — all survived. Original crash was likely accumulated heap stress from 35+ prior requests or coincidental Switch sleep timing.
